title: Serve European cached object switch tables and literals
changes: The e349-d348 generation serves 84 bytes across two guarded Thumb dispatch tables and 132 bytes across 33 original literal words.
Keeps e348-d347 compatible and retains all 154 other resources byte-for-byte.
validation: Windows build ctkdyxc5 and Wine mdbpggu3 passed 21 dispatch destinations, three bypasses, 33 literal readers, 75 typed requests, complete state and guest-clock equality, 420 mixed-width reads, two raw gaps and e348 attachment. The unit passed all 17 input guards and drained Wine.
The default CLI created, verified and reused all 157 files. Guarded staging ryyko0b0 retains the current e349 generation.
limitations: Live cached object and extent, ordinary and generated execution, original BIOS, native Linux and USA remain in the recovery checklist. No performance measurements.
